context: Customer liable for loss IF customer negligent

description: Provides an exception to customer liability in cases where the fraud was perpetrated by a bank staff member or involved unauthorized card use.
context: Exception: Fraud by staff member or unauthorized card use

context: FirstUK Bank reimburses 100% of unauthorized loss

description: Mandate that the bank must complete the reimbursement of unauthorized losses within 10 business days.

context: Bank liability depends on authentication strength

name: Card Present Fraud

description: The bank is liable for losses resulting from Card Present fraud, except in cases where the customer was negligent.

name: Card Cloning
description: A fraud risk where details are copied from a legitimate card to create a counterfeit card.

name: Account Takeover
description: A fraud scenario where a criminal gains unauthorized access to a legitimate customer account by compromising credentials such as passwords or security questions.
context: Criminal gains access to legitimate account (password, security questions)

description: An operational safeguard requiring the bank to immediately freeze an account upon detection or report of an account takeover to prevent further unauthorized activity.
